<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/access"}
#docs
May this customer spend now? Always 200: read `allowed` and `code`. Checks, first failure wins: `no_subscription`, `not_entitled`, `spend_limit_reached`, `in_flight_limit` (only with `estimate`), `insufficient_credit` (only when the customer's policy is to block), then `ok`. Writes nothing. 95% of access checks answer in less than 100 ms, measured at our server. Network time is not included. Needs `credits:view`.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |
| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | The customer's id (cus_…). |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meter` | `string` | no | The meter the call will use. |
| `estimate` | `integer` | no | The estimated cost in minor units. |
| `scope[<property>]` | `string` | no | A usage property value, for scoped spend limits. Up to 10. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `access_check`. One of `access_check`. |
| `allowed` | `boolean` | The access check's allowed. |
| `code` | `string` | The access check's code. One of `ok`, `insufficient_credit`, `spend_limit_reached`, `in_flight_limit`, `no_subscription`, `not_entitled`. |
| `message` | `string` | A sentence for your logs. |
| `customer` | `string` | cus_… |
| `meter` | `string` | The meter's id. |
| `currency` | `string` | ISO 4217. |
| `available_minor` | `integer` | Balance plus the overdraft limit. Can be negative. |
| `available_units` | `array of object` | The access check's available units. |
| `balance` | `object` | The access check's balance. |
| `on_exhausted` | `object` | The access check's on exhausted. |
| `usage_this_period` | `object` | The access check's usage this period. |
| `cost_this_period_minor` | `integer` | Rated usage of the meter this period. |
| `limits` | `array of object` | Spend limits checked. When the code is spend_limit_reached, only the tightest refusing limit. |
| `entitlement` | `object` | The access check's entitlement. |
| `renews_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the customer's plan credits next renew. Null = no plan credits renew. |
| `as_of` | `string · ISO-8601` | The access check's as of. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | The answer. |
| `400` | A parameter is not correct. |
| `404` | No such customer or meter. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customers/cus_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/access" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
